missing_information_behavior: Do not recommend switching from folic acid to methylfolate without reviewing current product and current local preconception guidance.
safety_exclusions: Do not delay folic acid while debating supplement forms; direct users to current local preconception guidance.
Do not claim 5-MTHF is proven superior for neural tube defect prevention.
Do not duplicate folate across products.
professional_escalation_conditions: Prior neural tube defect-affected pregnancy, antiseizure medicines, diabetes, malabsorption, obesity-related high-risk protocols or other high-risk obstetric history.
population_and_context: People planning pregnancy; adequate folic acid before conception and in early pregnancy is important for neural tube defect prevention, and 5-MTHF should not be assumed interchangeable for this evidence-based public-health recommendation.
dose_constraints: No individualized dose from this rule. Follow current local public-health/obstetric folic-acid recommendation; high-risk dosing requires clinician direction.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Folate and pregnancy guidance provide reference information; recommendations and high-risk protocols vary by jurisdiction. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
